selection_rule: baseline <tool_call> top-1; one prefix per trace; round-robin (tool identity, agent-tool depth) strata

next_causal_intervention.token_position: final prompt token / first generated-token prediction position
next_causal_intervention.suppression_operation: add -mean_diff at the hook; +mean_diff is the tool-call direction
next_causal_intervention.negative_control: norm-matched random direction at the same hook and token position
next_causal_intervention.required_control: same prefixes, no hook; report top-1, tool logit, probability, and generated behavior
